_note: Paths that sync_upstream.py must never overwrite or delete. Entries are matched by path prefix (relative to the fork root, '/' separated; a trailing '/' means a directory). Everything under a protected path is copied by neither the upstream-overwrite step nor the upstream-removal step, and upstream changes to it are only reported so a human can merge them by hand. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
_usage: Add fork-owned development paths here (e.g. "apps/my_new_app/"). Keep generated files out: mgu-repo.json is regenerated by fork-tools/gen_mgu_repo.py and must stay unprotected.
